visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at an outdoor ice skating rink in an urban plaza. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white and pink ski jacket and a fluffy white winter hat, smiles broadly at the camera. In the background, a man in a bright blue hooded jacket and a blue helmet stands on the ice. The setting is bright daylight with towering city buildings surrounding the large ice rink. (2) The woman is now on the ice, skating with her arms outstretched for balance. She wears pink ski pants and thick white gloves. Multiple people of various ages are skating in the background. The camera moves in a handheld, selfie-style manner, following her movements. A large building with a clock tower and a green banner featuring a cartoon dragon mascot is visible in the backdrop. (3) The camera focuses on the woman at a white ticket counter. She holds a small pink ticket and then displays a pair of black ice skates and a blue safety helmet to the camera. The background shows a white tent structure and several people queuing. The lighting remains bright and natural under a clear blue sky. (4) Footage shifts to the woman skating while being assisted by a man dressed in a black North Face puffer jacket. He gestures toward her feet, demonstrating skating techniques. They are near the edge of the rink, which is marked by a clear glass barrier with colorful banners. Other skaters move past them in blurred motion. (5) A close-up shot shows a row of small, brightly colored ice skates in red and blue, indicating children's equipment. A hand reaches out to touch one of the red skates. The scene then transitions to a specialized area marked with a 'GATE' sign, showing smaller children skating under supervision near orange traffic cones. (6) The video concludes with a full-screen text graphic displaying operational hours and dates. The woman reappears in the final moments, standing next to a large snow-covered sculpture of a traditional Korean 'Dolhareubang' figure, gesturing playfully toward the camera as people continue to skate in the wide-open background.

(2) At the 16-second mark, a faint metallic clinking sound triggers a phase shift as the narrator discusses ticket prices. The BGM remains consistent in tempo while short 'pop' sound effects punctuate the visual text overlays. (3) Around 26 seconds, a male voice with a calm, helpful tone enters the mix, providing instructions in Korean. The female narrator responds with a joyful exclamation, followed by sounds of fabric rustling and muffled laughter from background chatter. (4) As the focus moves to children's equipment at 40 seconds, a 'ding' sound effect marks the transition. The female vocal speed increases, listing age requirements while the BGM bass line becomes more prominent. (5) The final phase begins at 47 seconds with a subtle 'whoosh' transition sound as the speech shifts to operational details. The narrator's tone remains energetic and inviting until the track fades out with a final melodic flourish.
